battle.name: 秦滅趙之戰
battle.brief: 公元前228年，秦王政命大將軍王翦率軍東出，攻克太行八陘之一的井陘陘道，趙軍潰敗，趙王遷出降，趙國除代地外盡入於秦。前一年李牧才在開閩大破秦軍，卻被反間計除掉。卡面埃及長矛屬早王朝青銅工藝，與本役相隔逾三千年，不在戰場上；同期秦軍用鐵矛、秦戈、弩，趙軍以騎兵與弩手據險死守。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 這場戰爭是公元前229年至前228年秦王政對趙國的戰略決戰，是秦統一六國的第三步：此前前230年已滅韓，此後前225年滅魏。秦方由秦王政直接調度，以大將軍王翦為主將，兵源來自關中內史、漢中、上郡以及新附的韓地，糧秣由河內、上黨、晉陽三條線轉輸，沿途設亭障、烽燧與驛傳接力。趙方以邯鄲為都，前229年趙悼襄王中箭死於沙丘後由太子遷即位，年僅十三歲，代地則由長子嘉主持，李牧以大將軍身份掌兵權。秦軍的編制以步兵方陣為骨幹，車兵與騎兵分屬各將校，命令自秦王經丞相、將軍逐級下達，井陘一線的勝負往往決定數百里內諸城的歸屬。第三方並非袖手：匈奴在北線牽制秦的邊軍，燕、齊、楚各自結好自保，燕太子丹更曾西奔代地求援，試圖把秦的注意力引向別處，趙國因此始終孤立無援。
countriesEn: This war was the strategic decision of 229 to 228 BC in which the court of King Zheng of Qin moved against the state of Zhao, the third step in Qin's conquest of the six states: Han had already fallen in 230 BC, and Wei would fall in 225. The Qin side was directed personally by King Zheng, with the grand general Wang Jian as commander; the troops came from the Neishi region around the capital, from Hanzhong and Shang Commandery and from the newly annexed lands of Han, and the grain was moved along three supply lines through Henei, Shangdang and Jinyang, with barrier stations, beacon towers and a relay transport system strung along the road. The Zhao side was based at Handan; after King Dowang of Zhao was struck by an arrow and died at Shaqiu in 229 BC his son, still a boy of thirteen, succeeded him as King Qian, while the northern lands of Dai were administered by his elder brother Jia and Li Mu held the command of the army as general-in-chief. The other powers were not idle: the Xiongnu tied down Qin's frontier armies in the north, Yan, Qi and Chu each courted allies and husbanded their strength, and Yan prince Dan even fled west to Dai asking for help, hoping to draw Qin's attention elsewhere. Zhao was isolated throughout. The Qin order of battle rested on infantry formations, with chariots and cavalry distributed under their own commanders; orders passed from the king through the chancellor and the generals, and the outcome on the Jingxing line often decided the fate of towns hundreds of li away.
people: 秦王政嬴姓趙氏，前247年元年在位，前230年滅韓、前228年滅趙，前221年完成統一，前210年崩，年三十七；此役由他下詔發兵，而對李牧的處置只聽一面之詞，反間之計正是利用其多疑。大將軍王翦是本役主將，先破趙、再破燕，最後以六十萬大軍滅楚，是秦代最重的將才；其子王賁承父業，前222年攻燕拔薊城、前221年滅齊，滅代之役亦出秦軍。將軍桓齡是前229年秦軍取武安、太原、晉陽的主將，在開閩敗於李牧，後世或認為他即荊軻案中的樊於期。趙方最關鍵的人物是李牧：以少數兵力破秦軍於開閩、築井陘以守要隘，卻被趙王遷誤信反間、奪權收捕，最後自剄而死。趙悼襄王名宜，前276年立，前265年罷廉頗，前250年廢長子嘉立遷，前229年遇弒。趙王遷即位後受制於秦，國力由此一落千丈，終於被俘。代王趙嘉是趙國最後的流亡政權，前222年國滅。
peopleEn: King Zheng of Qin, of the Ying clan and the Zhao surname, took the throne in the first year of his reign in 247 BC, destroyed Han in 230 and Zhao in 228, unified the realm in 221 and died in 210 at the age of thirty-seven; it was he who ordered this campaign, and on the word of an informer he stripped Li Mu of his command, so the counter-intelligence plot worked precisely because of his mistrust. Wang Jian, grand general of Qin, commanded this war, went on to defeat Yan and finally to take Chu with six hundred thousand troops, and remains the heaviest military talent of the Qin state; his son Wang Ben continued the work, taking the city of Ji in Yan in 222 BC, destroying Qi in 221 and taking part in the reduction of Dai. General Huan Ling led the Qin troops that seized Wuan, Taiyuan and Jinyang in 229 BC and was beaten by Li Mu at Kailian; some later writers identify him with Fan Yuqi of the Jing Ke affair. On the Zhao side the decisive figure was Li Mu, who broke a Qin army at Kailian with a small force, built the works at Jingxing to guard the pass, and was then destroyed by a false report that the new king of Zhao believed, losing his command and finally his life by his own sword. King Dowang of Zhao, personal name Yi, took the throne in 276, dismissed Lian Po in 265, deposed his elder son Jia in favour of the younger prince Qian in 250, and was killed by an arrow in 229. King Qian of Zhao inherited the throne, was checked by Qin at every turn, and was finally taken prisoner. Zhao Jia, king of Dai, headed the last exile of the state and was captured when Dai fell in 222 BC.
kits: 卡面這件埃及長矛屬早王朝時期的工藝：青銅矛頭以綁扎或榫接固定在木杆上，是尼羅河流域最早一批成形的冷兵器，距本役已逾三千年，並不在井陘的戰場上。同源的想法卻跨越大陸：秦趙兩軍的長柄兵器同樣是金屬刃具加木杆，趙軍的戈有援、內、胡，裝在柲上；秦軍裝備大量鐵質戈、矛與秦劍，劍身修長、兩面開刃，配小盾與皮甲、札甲，並大量裝備弩兵，弩機技術在戰國晚期已由楚地傳入北方，成為秦軍壓制趙軍陣線最得力的兵器。趙國以胡服騎射立國，騎兵與車騎混編是其傳統，冶鐵發達的趙地出產細密鱗甲與良劍。雙方輜重都靠牛、馬、驢、騾挽車，秦軍自關中運糧近千里，雲梯、投石機等攻城器械則在破關之後才用得上。秦軍還備有戈、矛、戟等長兵與短兵相配的組合，鼓車用於進退之號，旗幟與金鼓制節，使大隊作戰不致在狹窄地形中自行潰散。
kitsEn: The Egyptian spear on the card is an artefact of the Early Dynastic period: a bronze head fixed to a wooden shaft by binding or mortise, one of the earliest cold weapons made in the Nile valley, more than three thousand years older than this campaign and therefore not present at Jingxing. The underlying idea, however, spans the continent: the long-hafted weapons of both Qin and Zhao are metal heads on wooden shafts in the same way, the ge of Zhao carrying yuan, nei and hu and being mounted on a shi, while Qin troops carried iron ge, spears and the Qin sword, a slender blade with two edges, accompanied by small shields, leather and lamellar armour, and large numbers of crossbowmen, the trigger mechanism of the crossbow having reached the northern states from Chu in the late Warring States period and become the most effective Qin weapon against the Zhao line. Zhao had risen on the reforms of King Wuling, and its cavalry and mixed horse-and-chariot formations were a tradition of its own, while the metallurgically advanced Zhao homeland produced fine lamellar armour and good blades. On both sides the trains were drawn by oxen, horses, donkeys and mules, the grain of Qin travelling nearly a thousand li from the capital region, while scaling ladders and stone-throwing engines came into play only after the pass had fallen. Qin troops also matched long arms such as the ge, the spear and the ji with short weapons, and used drum carts to signal advance and retreat, with banners and bronze gongs keeping the cadence, so that a large formation would not dissolve on its own in confined ground.
tactics: 秦國的戰略是《過秦論》所謂遠交近攻：與遠方的燕齊暫時修好，先並吞近處的韓趙魏，消滅各國的援手。井陘一役本身沒有漫長的圍城，關鍵在奪險與奇襲配合。前229年李牧在開閩設伏破秦軍，秦軍退回後沒有硬攻，改以反間除去李牧，不折一兵而拆掉趙國唯一能用的防線。前228年王翦主力自晉陽方向東出，取武安、太原、晉陽切斷趙國北翼，另以偏師沿河內策應，形成兩面夾擊；先鋒以步卒為主，狹窄的陘道車不盈軌，車兵難以展開，須以步卒結陣、弩手掩護，一鼓逼近趙軍陣腳。井陘關一破，趙軍退路斷絕，騎兵掩殺追潰，秦軍直抵邯鄲郊，趙王遷請降。得了邯鄲，趙國只剩代地，秦軍再以三年掃平。趙軍的失敗不全在裝備：代地與邯鄲之間的聯繫一旦被太原方向的秦軍切斷，井陘守軍便只能獨自死守，糧道與援軍都接不上。
tacticsEn: Qin's grand strategy was what the Essay on the Faults of Qin's Visitors called feasting with distant states and attacking the near ones: keeping on good terms with distant Yan and Qi while swallowing the nearby Han, Zhao and Wei one by one, so that no state could come to the aid of the next. The battle of Jingxing itself involved no long siege; the crux was the combination of seizing the pass and striking while the defence was divided. In 229 BC Li Mu ambushed and broke the Qin army at Kailian; Qin withdrew instead of forcing the issue and instead used a planted rumour to remove Li Mu, dismantling the only defence Zhao still had without losing a soldier. In 228 BC Wang Jian led the main body east from the direction of Jinyang, taking Wuan, Taiyuan and Jinyang to cut off Zhao's northern flank, while a detached force operated through Henei on the other side, so that Zhao was squeezed from two directions. The advance was led by infantry: the defile was so narrow that carts could not fill a track and a single cart barely squeezed through, so the chariot corps could not deploy, and the Qin had to close in with formed infantry covered by crossbowmen. Once Jingxing Pass fell, Zhao's line of retreat was cut, cavalry pursued and slaughtered the fugitives, the Qin reached the skirts of Handan, and King Qian of Zhao sued for peace. With Handan taken, only Dai remained, and three more years of Qin campaigning ended it. Zhao's defeat was not purely a matter of equipment: once the link between Dai and Handan was cut by the Qin troops moving through Taiyuan, the garrison at Jingxing could only hold on alone, with neither grain nor relief able to reach it.
data: 《史記》於此役只繫年份，不載月日；秦軍出師在秋，故繫於公元前228年。前229年李牧於開閩破秦、築井陘，前228年王翦破趙、虜趙王遷，前222年秦破代、虜趙嘉，前221年滅齊統一，自滅韓到滅齊的七年正是秦滅六國的全程。太行八陘中的井陘最為險要，陘道全長約數十里，最窄處車不盈軌，單車側身方能通過。兩軍確切兵員《史記》未載，可參照的是同時代秦軍一次出動二十萬眾的規模，見於前224年王翦伐楚的記載。史記於秦趙交鋒中屢用「斬首十萬餘」為量級，可見一場會戰的傷亡以萬計。關中咸陽至井陘前線陸路近千里，糧道長度遠超戰場本身。趙國地跨太行以東，都邯鄲，北抵代、雁門，南臨河內，井陘一失，畿輔盡露。趙國的兵制以步兵、車騎與縣邑武裝相配合，壯丁與糧秣的動員上限遠低於關中，歷年戰事又耗去大量人口，這是秦在長平之後仍能逐國取勝的關鍵。
dataEn: The Shiji gives only the year for this campaign and no month or day; the Qin army campaigned in the autumn, so the battle is placed in 228 BC. Li Mu broke Qin at Kailian and built the works at Jingxing in 229 BC; Wang Jian broke Zhao and took King Qian in 228; Qin took Dai and captured Zhao Jia in 222; Qi fell in 221, and the seven years from the fall of Han to the fall of Qi were the whole span of Qin's destruction of the six states. Jingxing, one of the eight passes of the Taihang range, was the most dangerous of them: the defile ran for some tens of li, and at its narrowest carts could not fill a track, a single cart having to edge through sideways. The Shiji does not record the exact numbers on either side, but a Qin army mustering two hundred thousand is attested for the same age, in the account of Wang Jian's campaign against Chu in 224 BC. The Shiji repeatedly uses a scale of more than a hundred thousand heads taken for Qin and Zhao clashes, showing that a single pitched battle cost tens of thousands of men. The land route from Xianyang in the capital region to the front at Jingxing ran close to a thousand li, so the grain line was far longer than the battlefield itself. Zhao's territory lay east of the Taihang range, with Handan as its capital, reaching Dai and Yumen in the north and Henei in the south; once Jingxing was lost the heartland lay open. Zhao's military system combined infantry, chariots and cavalry with county levies, and the ceiling on its manpower and grain was far lower than that of Guanzhong; repeated wars had drained its population further, and that was why Qin could still take the states one by one even after the battle of Changping.
cause: 秦滅趙不是偶然的兵禍，而是關中與山東六國百年競爭的收束。秦先滅韓（前230），打開太行山南北的孔道，趙國據太行以東、扼井陘之險，是秦東出的第一道屏障；而趙自武靈王胡服騎射以來，滅林胡、樓煩，斬首十萬，聲威壓迫關中，秦不能容忍這樣的鄰國存在。趙國自身則在內耗：罷廉頗而不能用李牧之長，廢長子嘉而立少子遷更是根本；前229年悼襄王中箭死於沙丘，十三歲的趙王遷即位，既無知兵之才，又輕信反間，先奪李牧兵權、再斬李牧，把前一年剛在開閩得勝的名將自毀。長期戰亂使趙地人口凋敝、兵源不足，前260年長平一役秦坑趙卒四十萬，趙國元氣二十八年未復。對秦而言，井陘是必須拔掉的釘子：只要井陘在，韓魏舊地就守不住。反間計之所以奏效，也在於趙廷君弱臣疑：悼襄王留下的太子既無威望，又無班底，詔令一下便可更換一員主將。
causeEn: The destruction of Zhao by Qin was not a chance raid but the closing of a century of rivalry between the Guanzhong heartland and the six states of Shandong. Qin took Han first in 230 BC, opening the corridors through the Taihang range, and Zhao, holding the eastern side of those mountains and the pass of Jingxing, was the first screen for Qin's march east; and Zhao had been formidable since King Wuling adopted the barbarian dress and mounted archery, defeating the Linhu and the Loufan and taking a hundred thousand heads, so that Qin could not tolerate such a neighbour. Zhao consumed itself from within: dismissing Lian Po in 265 without using Li Mu's talents, and above all deposing the elder son Jia in favour of the younger prince Qian in 250. When King Dowang was struck by an arrow and died at Shaqiu in 229, the thirteen-year-old Qian succeeded him, a boy with no experience of war who believed the first rumour he heard, took Li Mu's command from him and then had him killed, destroying the very general who had won at Kailian the year before. Years of war had thinned Zhao's population and its manpower, and the forty thousand Zhao soldiers buried alive by Qin after the battle of Changping in 260 BC had left the state short of strength twenty-eight years later. For Qin, Jingxing was a nail that had to be pulled out: as long as it held, the old lands of Han and Wei could not be held either. The counter-intelligence plot worked also because the Zhao court was weak in the sovereign and suspicious of its ministers: the heir left by King Dowang had neither prestige nor a party of his own, so a single order could replace a commander in the field.
impact: 趙亡之後，六國只餘魏、楚、燕、齊四家，秦的統一已不可逆轉。趙地改置郡縣，晉陽一帶入太原郡，代地置代郡，趙民被編入秦的編戶齊民，一部分被遷往榆中，一部分流散北方依附匈奴。趙亡使匈奴失去太行與代地兩道屏障，邊患隨之升級，秦稍後遣蒙恬北擊，取河南地築塞而守，終以河套為進取之資。兵器與技術層面，秦的鐵兵、弩機與冶鐵作坊隨郡縣制推向全國，邯鄲、鼓山一帶的冶鐵傳統被秦接收，漢承秦制，兵器形制自此定型。文化層面，趙國的鍾鼎銘文、封邑與世卿制度隨亡國而散，荀子入秦所見的官僚效率則是秦制的另一面；後世詩文把荊軻刺秦視為抗暴的最後一擊，而其背景正是秦滅趙國的這幾年，趙亡與荊卿的傳說就此綁在一起。趙地的鐵匠、弓弩匠戶被編入秦的作坊，兵器供應從此主要依賴關中與新併諸郡的冶鑄，弩兵制度亦隨郡縣制推廣到全國。
impactEn: After the fall of Zhao only Wei, Chu, Yan and Qi remained, and Qin's unification could no longer be reversed. Zhao's lands were reorganised into commanderies and counties, the Jinyang area passing into Taiyuan Commandery and Dai into Dai Commandery; the people of Zhao were enrolled in Qin's registers, some transported to Yuzhong and others dispersed northwards to take refuge with the Xiongnu. The loss of Zhao removed the Taihang and Dai screens from the Xiongnu and the frontier threat rose with them, so Qin later sent Meng Tian north, took the lands south of the Yellow River and built a line of forts, and made Hetao the springboard for further advance. At the level of arms and technique, Qin's iron weapons, crossbows and foundries travelled with the commandery system across the realm, the metallurgical traditions of Handan and Gushan being taken over by Qin; the Han inherited Qin's institutions, and the shapes of weapons were fixed from that time on. At the cultural level the bell-and-vessel inscriptions, the enfeoffed fiefs and the hereditary aristocracy of Zhao scattered with the state, while the administrative efficiency that Xunzi saw on his visit to Qin showed another side of the Qin system. Later poetry and history treat the assassination attempt of Jing Ke as the last blow against tyranny, and its background was precisely these years in which Qin destroyed Zhao; the fall of Zhao and the legend of Jing Ke have been bound together ever since. The ironworkers and crossbow makers of Zhao were enrolled in the Qin workshops; from then on the supply of arms rested mainly on the foundries of the capital region and the newly annexed commanderies, and the crossbow system spread nationwide with the commandery system.
result: 公元前228年，井陘關下秦軍破趙軍，趙王遷出降，趙國都邯鄲與太原、武安、宜安等核心地區盡入秦軍之手，趙國編制解體，兵散民逃。李牧已死，廉頗早為魏人，趙國再無能獨當一面的大將。餘下的代地由趙嘉以代王之名繼續抵抗，秦於前222年遣軍破代，虜趙嘉，遷趙民於榆中，趙姓政權最後一盞燈熄滅，太行八陘中通往山東的門戶自此洞開。趙國既平，秦得以專力東向：前225年滅魏，前224年至前223年滅楚，前222年滅燕，前221年滅齊，三年間完成統一，歷史由七雄並立走回一統。史家記此役，多以井陘一役為趙國的終局，而開閩得勝與井陘失守之間不過一年，中間的距離正是一條反間計的長度。秦軍入邯鄲之日，《史記》未載大屠，趙王的宗廟與社稷隨國璽一併沒入秦廷，趙國的歷史在史書中自此改以亡國之臣的筆墨續寫。
resultEn: In 228 BC the Qin army broke Zhao's force below Jingxing Pass, King Qian of Zhao came out to surrender, and Zhao's capital Handan together with Taiyuan, Wuan, Yi'an and the other heartlands passed into Qin's hands; the organisation of the state dissolved, soldiers scattered and the people fled. Li Mu was dead and Lian Po had long since gone to Wei, so Zhao had no general left who could hold the field alone. The remnant state of Dai under Zhao Jia continued to resist in the name of king of Dai; Qin broke it in 222 BC, took Zhao Jia prisoner and moved the people of Zhao to Yuzhong, and the last Zhao regime was extinguished. The gateway through the Taihang range to the lands of the east stood wide open. With Zhao settled, Qin could turn its whole strength eastward: Wei fell in 225, Chu in 224 and 223, Yan in 222 and Qi in 221, and unification was complete within three years, the age of seven contending states giving way to a single realm. Historians who write of this war generally take the battle of Jingxing as the end of Zhao, and between the victory at Kailian and the loss of Jingxing there was barely a year; the distance between them was the length of one planted rumour. On the day the Qin entered Handan the Shiji records no great slaughter; the ancestral temple and the altars of the king of Zhao went down with the state seal into the Qin court, and the history of Zhao was thereafter carried on in the writings of its exiled ministers.
